mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when real GDP growth declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when industrial production increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales signals a strengthening demand environment, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when both housing starts and retail sales increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% in a month signals deflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the consumer price index decreases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP and an increase in unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a month signals a weakening demand environment, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when both real GDP declines and the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.3%.
